headline: [Inside Story] Energy Self-Sufficiency Is National Security; Lai Government Pushes Wind Power with Added "Surveillance of Enemy Situations" Effect
summary: President Lai Ching-te has decided to go all-out on wind power development, instructing the Ministry of Economic Affairs on July 23. The move is framed around energy self-sufficiency.
why: Energy self-sufficiency matters for Taiwan, which imports most of its fuel. Expanded renewable capacity shapes demand for power equipment and utilities' investment plans.
